Prestige Office Ventures, subsidiary of the Company, alleging non-payment / short-payment of Goods & Services Tax/ Non-reversal of Input Tax Credit during the period from February 2020 to March 2024. As per the SCN, the subsidiary was required to show cause before the Additional/Joint Commissioner, Hyderabad CGST Commissionerate as to why GST amounting to Rs. 160.82 Crores along with equivalent amount of penalty and applicable interest should not be demanded from in terms of provisions of Section 74(1) of the CGST Act, 2017 read with other applicable provisions of the Act.

Prestige Mulund Realty Private Limited, subsidiary of the company, alleging Non-Payment/Short-payment of Goods & Services Tax. As per the SCN, the Company is required to show cause before the Additional/Joint Commissioner, CGST & Central Excise Mumbai East Commissionerate, within 30 days of receipt of the SCN as to why GST amounting to Rs. 153.60 Crores along with equivalent amount of penalty and applicable interest should not be demanded from in terms of provisions of Section 74(1) of the CGST Act, 2017 read with other applicable provisions of the Act.

industry: Consumer Discretionary > Realty > Residential, Commercial Projects

operating_notes.text: Prestige Golden Grove in Hyderabad achieved over ₹2,500 crore in sales across 1,700 units within two weeks of launch.
Q4FY26 land cost was ₹1,480.8 Cr against ₹2,393.8 Cr in Q4FY25, while contractor cost rose to ₹2,370.7 Cr from ₹1,110.3 Cr.
FY26 operating cash flow of ₹3,223.2 Cr included a ₹7,824.6 Cr increase in other liabilities and a ₹6,844 Cr rise in trade receivables.
The Group acquired 50% partnership interest in Aaramnagar Realty LLP after 31 March 2026.
FY26 sales of ₹30,025 Cr and collections of ₹18,515 Cr were the company's highest-ever operational performance, per the May 2026 press release.
FY26 revenue of ₹13,196 Cr was 71% above FY25, while EBITDA grew 43%, so margin expansion did not keep pace with revenue growth.
H1 FY27 pre-sales reached ₹13,804 Cr with 7,247 units sold; collections stood at ₹10,096 Cr.
Consummated first tranche of CPPIB investment in PHVL comprising ₹950 Cr equity purchase from the company and ₹550 Cr primary CCPS subscription.

timeline.summary: Prestige Estates reported ₹2,500 crore in early pre-sales from the launch of Prestige Golden Grove in Hyderabad.
FY26 results (consolidated, press release): revenue ₹13,196 Cr (+71% YoY), PAT ₹1,312 Cr (+112.8% YoY), FY26 sales ₹30,025 Cr and collections ₹18,515 Cr.
27 May 2026: Prestige Estates filed the transcript of its Q4 & FY26 earnings conference call held on May 22, 2026.
Prestige Estates reported H1 FY27 pre-sales of ₹13,804 crore and announced a ₹3,000 crore strategic investment by CPP Investments in its hospitality unit on October 13, 2026.
Prestige Estates consummated the first tranche of its strategic hospitality partnership with CPPIB for ₹1,500 crore.
